brog.definition:
n. A pointed instrument, as a joiner's awl, a brad awl, a
   needle, or a small sharp stick.
v. t. To prod with a pointed instrument, as a lance; also, to
   broggle.
brog.translation: 曲柄钻, 曲柄手摇钻, 刺棒

brogan.definition: n. a thick and heavy shoe

brogans.definition:
plural of brogan
n. a thick and heavy shoe
brogans.translation: (brogan 的复数) n. (粗革高帮)劳动靴

brogden.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 布罗格登住所名称，来源于古英语，含义是“小河+河谷”(brook+valley)

broglie.definition: n. French nuclear physicist who generalized the wave-particle duality by proposing that particles of matter exhibit wavelike properties (1892-1987)

brogue.definition: n a thick and heavy shoe
brogue.translation: n. 土腔, 拷花皮鞋

brogues.translation: n. 土音（尤指爱尔兰人讲英语时的土腔）, （旧时爱尔兰人穿的）粗革皮鞋( brogue的名词复数 )
